answer_2.quote: We use two automatic metrics to assess the quality of the poisoned samples, namely perplexity calculated by GPT-2 language model and grammatical error numbers given by Language-Tool.

answer_4.quote: We first conduct manual data inspection to measure the invisibility of different backdoor attacks... we ask annotators to make a binary classification for each sample, i.e., original human‑written or machine perturbed.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators perform binary classification for each sample: human‑written vs. machine‑perturbed.
